entities.title: zazzle investigate
entities.summary: `zazzle investigate QUESTION --path P.. --symbol S..` (also `agent investigate`, MCP zazzle_investigate): the user's local model resolves a repository question with bounded read-only lookups, and the agent gets findings whose path:line citations zazzle checked against the files.
entities.purpose: With no starting symbol (or none that resolves), discover.rs turns the question into terms and, before any inference, lists the declarations inside the scope whose names, route attributes or paths match (production code before tests, simulators and fakes; a route naming an HTTP method first for a web question) under handles D1, D2, and reads the best one with its attributes; the model can ask for more with SYMBOL words and READ a handle, and a READ of a bare name looks up declarations. A reply with any lookup line is a lookup turn, so a lookup sent with a confidence line runs; an answer starts with ANSWER, and a confidence or status line alone answers nothing. A finding whose quoted names are not in its cited lines, or that says one name falls back to another while citing them in the other order, is rejected; the run is complete only with a verified finding. mod.rs parses the command and resolves the starting symbols before any inference: their refs inside the scope and the bodies of their first two declarations are the first evidence, and a symbol with none gets real files and symbols in the scope that resemble it (seed.rs); when no symbol is there and nothing resembles any, it returns a no-evidence report without asking the model. It then asks the local model for up to three READ, REFS, OUTLINE or FIND lookups per turn, runs them through zazzle's own commands confined to the scope, never runs the same lookup twice (same file and range, or same words; the model is told it has the output or that it failed), and stops at its answer (FINDING and UNKNOWN lines, with or without an ANSWER line), at the turn limit, when the seen text passes ~12,000 tokens, on a second unusable reply (the first is shown back to it with the format), after two turns of only repeated lookups or on a model failure; a stop quotes how the last reply began. A run that gathered evidence but stopped without an answer (an empty answer, a lookup on the last turn, turns of only repeats or of neither lookups nor an answer) gets one answer-only turn; when no finding is verified the report is PARTIAL and carries ranked verbatim excerpts (each lookup's first line and the lines naming a word of the question or a starting symbol, two lines around them, lookups with more such lines first, each file line once, up to ~3,000 tokens) and the lookups that found nothing. One deadline set when the daemon accepts the job (--seconds, default 90) bounds waiting for and starting the shared model, seed resolution, every lookup (indexer requests are cut off with it, through budget.rs) and the answer: nothing new starts after it, and a partial result keeps the evidence and the stop reason. Every job is kept as a run (runs.rs) under --run-id or a new id: usage as each call ends, the result before the reply; the same id returns it without asking any model again. `--run-id ID --cancel` stops the run at once and keeps what it gathered. A READ or OUTLINE of a file that does not exist is refused once for every range, with the real files and symbols in scope whose names resemble it. The rules for files the model reads come back as notes on a separate ledger (`SESSION>local`) and go into its system message, never into the evidence; the caller's own ledger gets the rules for the cited files. cite.rs reads the ANSWER block and checks each FINDING: inside a scope entry, an existing text file, a valid line range, then quotes up to 12 cited lines. The answer also carries the model's report on itself (CONFIDENCE understanding=… result=…, and when needed ESCALATE with CONTEXT lines or BLOCKED access|decision), shown in the report; explore, work and finish give the adaptive mode the run and its checked, structured result, and --context passes it what an earlier attempt established. cache.rs holds what one job's threads share: each lookup and declaration scan runs once per job (another part asking for one in flight waits for it; outputs and definitive misses are kept, transient errors are tried again), and each lookup that found something is appended to the run's evidence as it happens; the scans stop reading files once the job is cancelled or out of time.
boundaries: Read-only: lookups are read, refs, outline and find, never edit or run.
A READ or OUTLINE outside the scope is refused and the refusal is shown to the model; REFS and FIND are run on the scope paths only.
The model's claims are not verified, only its citations: the report says so.
The model loads once: Model asks through daemon's shared worker (llm::ask), which stays loaded across the turns and after the run until ZAZZLE_LLM_IDLE seconds unused.
